$comment: Citations that are PROVENANCE rather than a live gate, read by scripts/reconcile-stable-orphans.ts (#1783).
An entry silences exactly one spec's citations, and must list every reference it covers.

It is verified in BOTH directions (#1084's lesson): if the spec carries @stable again, becomes lane-gated, is renamed away, or stops citing a declared reference, the declaration is REPORTED as expired instead of being honoured silently — otherwise this check grows the exact silent-expiry problem it exists to close.
A LIVE gate does not belong here. Cite an open issue in the justification instead: one open reference is enough for the check to leave the spec alone.
